companyAnnouncements: The librarian is in. Drop copies into inbox/ and run /shelve, or run /withdraw to take a source out.

tips: Drop copies into inbox/, then run /shelve.
Run /withdraw to take a source out of the library.
Run /digest on a head to write its map from its sources.
Cite a source on a page as [@slug, place].
Every head starts in private/. Move its folder into heads/ to publish it.
A source stays private until you run bin/commonplace.py identify ID public:yes.
Arrange shelf/ in any folders you like, and keep each link's name.
